sit_stay_shake.purpose: One policy for sit entry, unlimited idle, either paw shake, and exit

spider_clips.purpose: Enter, hold, and leave the precise spider-walking stance

spider_walk.purpose: Initial reward hypothesis, requiring measured speed/clearance evaluation before deployment
spider_walk.rationale: Retain the recorded StableGait objectives; reward low-body support, penalize sliding/falls and effort. Abduction penalty remains zero because intentional splay is essential. Runtime speed limits must come from evaluation, not these training bounds.

generated_trick.purpose: Track a generated, inspected, repaired motion supplied with --motion
